{{Quote|We have found an enormous cavern at the end of this passage that appears promising! I believe we could construct long-term shelter there.|Melorae}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Nomai]] from [[the Vessel]] who landed on [[Ember Twin]] with [[Escape_Pods|Escape Pod 2]].<ref>MELORAE: The heat from this star system’s sun is more bearable below the surface.
MELORAE: When our escape pod punctured this planet’s surface, it broke into what scans show is a cave system with much cooler air. I would recommend we seek a site down there to build a long-term shelter, Annona, but these passages are a maze!</ref> She was the aunt of [[Thatch]] and the mentor of [[Coleus]].<ref>THATCH: Is the hardest part of this tragedy not knowing who we may have lost? Or will the hardest part come later, when we learn? (Be well, Aunt Melorae...)</ref><ref>COLEUS: My hypothesis was correct! I can travel on this rock, as long as I’m not observing my surroundings (meaning I must be in complete darkness). I’m going to bring my mentor here to see this. COLEUS: Melorae is here now, too. We theorize when a conscious being is in contact with a quantum object and ceases to observe his or her surroundings, the being can become entangled with that quantum object, and they move together.</ref>

==Life on Ember Twin==
After landing on Ember Twin, Melorae noticed that the heat from the [[Sun]] was much more bearable beneath the surface of the planet.<ref>MELORAE: The heat from this star system’s sun is more bearable below the surface.</ref> She recommended to [[Annona]] that they should build a long-term shelter in Ember Twin's cave system.<ref>MELORAE: The heat from this star system’s sun is more bearable below the surface.
MELORAE: When our escape pod punctured this planet’s surface, it broke into what scans show is a cave system with much cooler air. I would recommend we seek a site down there to build a long-term shelter, Annona, but these passages are a maze!</ref> She and Coleus ended up finding the cavern that the [[Sunless City]] would be built in.<ref>MELORAE: We have found an enormous cavern at the end of this passage that appears promising! I believe we could construct long-term shelter there.</ref> 

In the Sunless City, Melorae and Coleus studied the [[Anglerfish]] fossil, learning that it died from starvation and did not originate from  Ember Twin.<ref>COLEUS: This anglerfish’s digestive tract suggests death by starvation. MELORAE: Visually, the specimen appears to be of the same species as the anglerfish in Dark Bramble. We don’t believe it originated from this planet.</ref> They also found out that Anglerfish are blind, a fact that the children playing the Anglerfish game incorporated into their game.<ref>COLEUS: An update: Melorae, while I was here making sketches of the anglerfish, I observed the children I saw earlier playing here again. They’ve added a rule to their game that incorporates our research (it’s wonderful)!</ref> Melorae was delighted upon hearing this, as she thought that it was never too early to appreciate biology.<ref>MELORAE: I’m entirely delighted! It’s never too early to appreciate biology!</ref>

==Studying phenomena== 
Melorae also remarked on the presence of the [[Quantum Moon]], which she discussed with [[Bur]] and Annona.<ref>MELORAE: This planet sometimes (and only sometimes) has a moon! This is also of note: It disappears if no one is watching it! Isn’t that a fascinating orbital characteristic?</ref> She believed that the Nomai should study it or in the best case, travel to it.<ref>MELORAE: This is my first time encountering a natural satellite with the ability to vanish when not being watched. We should study it! Or, even better, we should travel there!</ref> This led to the building of the [[Hourglass_Twins#Quantum_Moon_Locator|Quantum Moon locator]]. Once it was functioning, Melorae observed the Quantum Moon orbiting [[Dark Bramble]].<ref>MELORAE: Annona, Bur, I just observed the Quantum Moon in orbit around Dark Bramble. ANNONA: You have keen eyes, my friend. So this moon travels to a total of five locations, not four. BUR: I added a marker for Dark Bramble.</ref> When the locator sometimes could not find the moon's location, Melorae proposed the possibility of a [[Eye of the Universe|Sixth Location]] that the moon orbits.<ref>BUR: I thought the locator now accounted for all of the phantom moon’s locations, but sometimes the locator can’t tell where the moon is. Perhaps there’s a problem with the device? MELORAE: It’s also possible there exists a sixth place in this star system to which the phantom moon travels.</ref>

Along with Coleus, Melorae studied the rocks on Ember Twin, finding out that the [[Quantum_Shards|Cave Shard]] wanders around just like the Quantum Moon does.<ref>COLEUS: An update: Melorae and I went back to the Lakebed Cave and observed this rock again. Sometimes it’s there, and sometimes it isn’t. MELORAE: That means this rock wanders like the Quantum Moon does. How curious!</ref> However, when Coleus was standing on the Cave Shard, Melorae turned away to take notes when her lantern died.<ref>Melorae: We were examining the different rocks. I recall Coleus standing on the largest one (the wandering rock). I was taking notes, and then my lantern died.</ref> Coleus disappeared along with the rock, and Melorae became deeply worried for him as he had a limited supply of air.<ref>MELORAE: I turned away from Coleus to examine a sample, and when I turned back, he simply wasn’t there anymore. He had a limited supply of air, Annona! I’m afraid for him!</ref> Nomai from the Sunless City came to help, but nobody could find Coleus.<ref>BUR: Melorae, some of us from the Sunless City are here to help search for Coleus. Can you tell us more about your expedition? MELORAE: You have my gratitude, Bur! Coleus and I were studying the caves’ geology. We hoped to learn more about a unique and wandering rock that visits several different caves in the area.</ref> Eventually, Coleus realized he had become quantum entangled with the rock and was able to free himself.<ref name=coleus>COLEUS: Melorae is here now, too. We theorize when a conscious being is in contact with a quantum object and ceases to observe his or her surroundings, the being can become entangled with that quantum object, and they move together.</ref> He brought Melorae over to see the phenomenon, and while she congratulated him on discovering a new quantum rule, she did make him promise not to vanish again.<ref name=coleus/><ref>MELORAE: Friends, Coleus has discovered a new quantum rule! (He has also promised me he’ll never vanish again, even if he does learn something useful from it!)</ref>

==Legacy==
Melorae passed away at some unknown point before the [[Ash Twin Project]] started. While excavating ore on [[Timber Hearth]], Coleus noted that she would have enjoyed the presence of the [[Hearthian|Hearthians]]' ancestors.<ref name=mentor>COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I imagine she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.</ref>
== Trivia ==

* ''[[Wikipedia:Cyanidioschyzon merolae|Cyanidioschyzon merolae]]'' is a unicelular red alga, considered the simplest of eukaryotic cells.
